historical_record.description: The property then held an industrial building of approximately 3,000 square feet.
The City Planning Commission disapproved the conditional use authorization to construct dwelling units in the M-1 district.
The City Planning Commission took discretionary review and disapproved the project to demolish an existing industrial building and construct a nine-unit building.
